title: Four looks under the fan
brief: A pink rabbit rolls off the sofa. A walnut ceiling fan sweeps past to reveal a floral skirt, a blue bubble dress, and an indigo denim look with a burgundy bow.
production: Three five-second Pika shots generated on a 40-core Apple M5 Max with 128 GiB. The final frame of each preceding shot guides the next. The edit keeps the generated stereo tracks.
